text:
ashwin: Quick callout — planning a 90‑min Terraform bootcamp for Cloud Marketplace partners next Wed. Goal: help them wire up Redwood Dedicated modules and marketplace packaging. Who can lead content?
sofia: I can lead the partner-facing demo. Will need a minimal example that provisions Dedicated capacity and an IAM/service account. +1 for hands-on.
liam: I'll do module review and CI bits. Have a sample repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-terraform-examples
anita: What about VPC/private deployment steps? Partners often ask about KMS/HSM integration and subnet mapping.
ashwin: Good call — include a slide + lab step for KMS. Also let's surface these files in the repo: modules/dedicated/main.tf and packaging/marketplace.yaml
deveng: Prereq checklist idea: partner cloud account, org role, service principal/keypair, Terraform >=1.4, aws/gcp CLI configured.
sofia: +1. Can we keep the lab to 30–40 minutes: 15m demo, 30m hands-on, 10m Q&A.
liam: I'll wire up CI smoke test and a small GH Action that runs `terraform init && terraform validate` on the example.
nashwin: Owner assignment: content -> @sofia, repo + CI -> @liam, security checklist -> @anita. I'll send calendar invites to partner PMs and SEs.
anita: I'll add KMS/HSM notes and a short checklist for on-prem (air-gapped) customers. Link to compliance playbook: https://internal.redwood/docs/compliance/marketplace-kms.md
deveng: can we have a minimal TF snippet for the lab? I'll paste a tiny example below.
deveng: ```hcl
module "redwood_dedicated" {
  source       = "git::https://github.com/redwood-inference/terraform//modules/dedicated"
  region       = "us-west-2"
  instance_type = "g4dn.xlarge"
}
```
sofia: perfect — I'll turn that into a hands-on; can we also include a step that shows how to pin model versions and enable autoscale in staging?
liam: yes, will add an example `variables.tf` and a small script to toggle autoscale for the lab environment.
nashwin: timeline: draft agenda by EOD Fri, lab PR + CI by Mon, final dry run Tue. Can everyone confirm?
sofia: confirmed :white_check_mark:
liam: confirmed :white_check_mark:
anita: confirmed :white_check_mark:
cloud-partner-bot: Standup reminder scheduled for 2024-04-03 15:00 UTC (added partners: acme-cloud, bluewave-systems)
nashwin: thanks all — ping me if you need partner contact info or extra infra credits.
